sanskrit: kiṃ punarbhaktibhāvena sākṣānmuktipradaṃ nṛṇām | karmādhīnaṃ tu ye mūḍhā vadaṃti tvāṃ krṛpānidhim || 40 || te na jānaṃti bhagavankarmaivaṃ preritaṃ tvayā | ajāmilena vipreṇa tyaktvā varṇāśramoditam || 41 ||
english: 40-41a. You are the bestower of salvation on men who see you directly. What of those who are prompted with the feelings of devotion? (They will certainly be liberated.) Those are fools who aver that you who are a storehouse of mercy, are subject to Karma. They do not know that Karma itself has been directed by you.
